bio.text: Ballotpedia lists Christopher Campbell as the Kentucky Party candidate in the November 3, 2026 U.S. Senate general election in Kentucky.

According to a press release he issued announcing his campaign, he is a Kentucky Party Executive Committee member, a 30-year-plus resident of Kentucky and a former member of the Kentucky National Guard.
The release states that he graduated from Eastern Kentucky University with a master of public health degree in 2019 and has worked in hospitals, health departments and nursing homes.

sources.title: Press Release: Campbell declares intent to run for Senate
